170. To Meet Another Friend, Dante (1)
Valeria Hister.
Two months before Jin returned from Lafrarosa, she finally discovered that the fifth tomb of Temar was somewhere in the Caldoran Snowfield.
This was thanks to the restoration of the words she left behind with record magic while tracing the movements of Luntia.
And from the moment she set off for the Caldoran Snowfield with Nero, Valeria was pursued by three forces.
Runcandel, Zipfel, and the Royal Family.
Runcandel was mainly the Black Sword Society, Black Knights, and subordinate knights, and Zipfel was led by Ronil in the pursuit.
And although they occasionally found or encountered Valeria, that was all.
The real crisis for Valeria was the Royal Family.
The reason why Valeria was pursued so desperately that she couldn't contact Tikan for two months was because of the Royal Family.
"Does the royal family have such excellent pursuers......? Even the top powers of the Garden of Swords and Zipfel couldn't find Valeria."

"Although I am from the Special Forces, whether it's the Special Forces or the Personal Guard, they can't compare to the Black Sword Society's 1st tier or Black Knights. Even if they've become stronger through the power of Chaos or through becoming a demon...... I don't know. The same goes for Rosa's subordinates and Zipfel."
Valkas and Alisa said.
Jin was summarizing and conveying the stories he heard from Valeria during the trip to Tikan to his colleagues.
"Among the royal pursuers, there were a few exceptional individuals, and they turned out to be knights of the Garden of Swords."
"Did the royal family betray Zipfel?"
"Yes, they did."

"Just a short time ago, they pledged their loyalty to Zipfel, bringing the eastern part of the Empire...... Hmm. The giving of the East was a smokescreen, or perhaps they recognized the power of the Garden of Swords and changed their stance."

"I think it's the former, Sir Valkas. I have a feeling that the Royal Family may have contacted Runcandel much sooner than we think. They... have part of the body of the first head of the family, so they could have made a deal with it."
Even Valeria couldn't find out exactly when the Royal Family betrayed Zipfel. It wasn't that important a problem.

-As far as we have examined, the body of Temar Runcandel itself was no different from a collection of information on ancient magic in its heyday. Although we didn't have a chance to properly analyze it due to the transaction going awry.
It was a story heard from the Kinzelo side when they were sharing the space-time device.
"Jin, you said you saw a tremendous number of bio-golems of Magic Swordsmen at the holy ground of Zipfel."

"Yes, Quintell. We cannot rule out the possibility that they shared their left arms in both the Garden of Swords and Zipfel. That's why Zipfel might not have noticed the betrayal of the Royal Family."
"...Even a thousand years later, he can't rest. His body is torn apart and sent here and there. It's fortunate that Murakan is not here."
"What do you mean the Sword Emperor is in danger?"
"Some of the royal pursuers I encountered were killed, and I looked at their records. Among them, there was this content."
<The Runcandel of... Runcandel gives a monster to Iran Vermont of the Vermont royal family, ordering him to kill Dante Hairan, the Sword Emperor.>

"If it's Iran Vermont, he was in the top 30 in the line of succession to the throne before Amir died. I don't know the details about him, and neither does Alisa, but he wasn't particularly noticeable. It seems he is a major contact with Runcandel."
Kashmir had little contact with Amir and Iran during his life in the royal family.
The rank difference was so severe that they hardly met, and the Vermont royal family had a strong tendency to hide themselves even among the same royal family.
"It's like a completely new person, so we need to start collecting information about him from scratch."
"Don't worry, My Lady! I'll find out even the color of this Iran guy's underwear."
"But the part about giving out a monster... Does it mean a knight of Runcandel corrupted by chaos? It's strange that the name of the person who gave out the monster is not clearly stated."
"There is one person that comes to mind."
Jin said, squinting his eyes.
"Joshua Runcandel... I have a strong intuition that it's him."
"My Lord, that dog... Ahem, that worthless bastard! Did Rosa revive him?"
At Gilly's angry reaction, Jin smiled.

"If he succeeded in rebellion while my father was away, there's no reason to keep a dog that was obedient. Although he kept showing trash-like behavior before, he might have changed now. Or rather, he was forced to change. Through the power of Chaos."
"That's a filthy and despicable story. When I think of him and Rosa, I feel so furious that it's hard to bear."
"But if it's Joshua, why wouldn't his name be accurately recorded in the record magic?"
"Well, it might be because he accepted chaos and became a completely new existence. Of course, I can't be sure, it's just an intuition."

"Anyway, it seems like there are three main things we need to start immediately. The first is to check on the Sword Emperor, the second is to rescue our remaining forces within Huphester, and the last is... to enter the sixth tomb of Temar, which Valeria found."
At Quintell's summary, Jin nodded.
"That's right. It seems that all three are things I need to move on directly."
The notable allies remaining in Hupester are Bin Bransch and his contracted chief blacksmith, the new Picon Minche.

In addition, Jin's butler Petro, Chiron's butler and the head butler Heinz, the nannies and relatives of the 'Brothers', and various people who are presumed not to have conspired with Rosa, and the red people who may be in Luna's territory.
Among them, there are not many people who can actually help, excluding Bin Bransch or high-ranking relatives.
However, they couldn't just leave them alone, even if they were not a force.
That's not the way of Jin, the Vamel Alliance.
Above all, the Garden of Swords may not care about them for some reason right now, but it was a risk that Rosa could use them as hostages at any time.
"No, it seems better for you to be out of the rescue of allies inside Hupester."
"I think so too, Confucius."
"Confucius, I think so too!"
The colleagues unanimously opposed Jin's re-entry into Hupester.

"It's a miracle that you came back safely from the Caldran Snowfield this time. You are the head of the Vamel Alliance and the center of the temporary alliance, and the only match for Rosa. So, until the day you come to a conclusion with Rosa, stop thinking about going to Hupester directly."
The moment Jin tried to answer, Mary put her hand on his shoulder.

"Yes, youngest. We know that you are the strongest among us and therefore you try to bear a lot. But that doesn't mean you have to step in for everything. Even Father didn't do that. Exactly, it must have been impossible."
"Sister."

"I will gather people and go to rescue the insiders in Hupester. In case you worry, I'll say in advance, even if I see Diphus... if I see Diphus in the same state as Luntia during the process, don't lose your cool, never."
"I will also ask for help from Mume. Although almost all the personnel are looking for Lady Yona, some will surely support."
Jin could not persist against the firm attitudes of his siblings and colleagues.
"I understand. Anyway, I have to move directly to the Sword Sovereign and the Tomb of Temar. I thought it was excessive for me to move directly, I just didn't want to admit it. That thought."
"To the Sword Sovereign, are you going right away?"
"Yes, I plan to listen to the rest of the story when Valeria wakes up and then go."
On the way back, Valeria was telling the past stories inside the Koshek, but she lost consciousness due to the remaining soul.
It wasn't a fatal problem, but because of that, she was receiving help from the Chaos Purifier without being able to tell Jin about the information about the sixth tomb.
"I understand."
"I really want to see that Dante guy."
After returning from Lafrarosa, Jin has not met Dante even once.
It was because there had been an endless series of events since his return.
Moreover, as Jin personally stepped in for almost everything in the Vamel Alliance, Dante played that role in the Empire.
Currently, there are hardly any superhuman-level individuals left in the Empire except Dante.
Given the loss of the Empire's top talents during the Gliek extermination battle, Dante has a lot of responsibilities.
Perhaps because the shock received from Veradin was large, Jin felt comforted just thinking about meeting Dante soon, even though it's not for a good occasion.
He felt that even if Dante faced a crisis, he would be able to handle it well.
"I wish I could meet a healthy friend without any troubles and cool my head."
"You're right, sir. If the character found in Valeria's records is that dreg, he won't be able to threaten you no matter what he does."
Of course, it wasn't really Gilly saying this out of no concern. However, it was hard for the colleagues to imagine Jin falling into a crisis because of Joshua.
Knock, knock, someone came to the meeting room.
It was Qwaul and Valeria.
As soon as Valeria returned, Qwaul had piled up cigarette butts like a mountain in front of the hospital room, waiting only for Valeria to come out, and brought her as soon as she woke up.
"Uhuhuhuk!"
Suddenly, Qwaul hugged Jin and burst into tears. No one had ever thought of this rough and rugged engineer weeping like a child.
"You did it... you did well! You really saved our Valeria...!"
The colleagues had already been aware of this from earlier, but seeing Qwaul crying was both unsightly and pitiful, so they comforted him for a while.
Valeria, too, did not protest at Qwaul's reaction, though she opened her eyes wide.
"Uhuhuhuk, the chaos is completely gone!"
"You passed out because of the chaos and couldn't finish the story, Jin. Where did I leave off?"
"It was the location of the sixth tomb."
"Ah, that's right. The place where Temar's sixth tomb exists is not a region, Jin."
"Not a region? You mean a subspace?"
At that, Valeria nodded her head and responded.
"Yes, it's a subspace. But it's a specific sword that contains a subspace, not a region."
